    #sentinel is a #guard

].

[
    @mara is a #captain
    @henry is a #sentinel
    @north gate is a #door
    @brass bell is a #device
    @iron key is a #key
].

START
[
    PLAYER has 0 score
    PLAYER has 12 health
    PLAYER has 0 victories
    PLAYER has 0 setbacks
    PLAYER has "Ready for the trial." motto
    @mara is calm
    @henry is calm
    @north gate is closed
    @north gate has "A heavy gate built to take a beating." description
    @iron key is on the #door
].

[
    A moves PLAYER left at 6 speed
    D moves PLAYER right at 6 speed
    SPACE makes PLAYER jump at 10 speed
].

HOVER for #door
[
    name
    kind
    state
    description
].

CONTEXT for #door
[
    "Open" when it is closed (change it to open
    "Close" when it is open (change it to closed
    "Examine" (cause PLAYER examines it
].

WHEN PLAYER attacks a #guard
[
    |then (damage it by 1
    |then (change it to angry
    |then (cause it attacks PLAYER
].

[
    |then (decrease health of PLAYER by 1
].

WHEN PLAYER sounds @brass bell
[
    |then (damage every #guard by 1
    |then (increase score of PLAYER by 1
].

WHEN PLAYER takes @iron key
[
    |then (carry @iron key
].

WHEN PLAYER opens @north gate
[
    |then (change @north gate to open

].

WHEN PLAYER closes @north gate
[
    |then (change @north gate to closed
    |then (change motto of PLAYER to "The gate is closed."
].

IF PLAYER has at least 2 score and @north gate is open
[
    |then (increase victories of PLAYER by 1
].
OTHERWISE
[
    |then (increase setbacks of PLAYER by 1
].

IF PLAYER has less than 1 health or @mara is dead
[
    |then (change PLAYER to dead
